import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import seaborn as sns
import io

# Data provided by the user
csv_data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set a professional and clean plot style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")

# Create the figure and axes
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 8), dpi=120)

# Create the bubble chart
# x-axis: price_usd
# y-axis: megapixels
# bubble size: max_iso
# bubble color: brand
# bubble style: body_type
scatter = sns.scatterplot(
    data=df,
    x='price_usd',
    y='megapixels',
    hue='brand',
    size='max_iso',
    style='body_type',
    sizes=(200, 2500),
    palette='viridis',
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='black',
    linewidth=1,
    ax=ax
)

# Add annotations for each point for clarity
for i in range(df.shape[0]):
    plt.text(
        x=df['price_usd'][i] + 50,
        y=df['megapixels'][i] + 0.5,
        s=f"{df['brand'][i]} ({df['model_year'][i]})",
        fontdict=dict(color='black', size=10)
    )

# --- Customize the plot for better readability ---

# Set title and subtitle
fig.suptitle(
    'Camera Feature Comparison: Price vs. Megapixels',
    fontsize=18,
    fontweight='bold',
    y=0.98
)
ax.set_title(
    'Bubble size corresponds to Max ISO. Shape indicates Body Type.',
    fontsize=12,
    pad=10
)

# Format axes
ax.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Megapixels (MP)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# Format x-axis labels as currency
formatter = mticker.FormatStrFormatter('$%.0f')
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(formatter)

# Adjust grid and tick parameters
ax.grid(which='major', linestyle='--', linewidth='0.5', color='gray')
plt.xticks(rotation=0)
plt.tick_params(axis='both', which='major', labelsize=10)

# Adjust legend position to be outside the plot area
ax.legend(
    loc='upper left',
    bbox_to_anchor=(1.02, 1),
    borderaxespad=0,
    title='Legend',
    title_fontsize='13',
    fontsize='10'
)

# Ensure everything fits without overlapping
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0, 0.85, 0.95]) # Adjust rect to make space for the legend

# Save the resulting plot
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
